# Vrumo AI

> Vrumo AI is a real estate CRM and WhatsApp lead-management platform for Indian property developers, channel partners and real estate agents. It qualifies WhatsApp enquiries (project, budget, country, purpose, timeline, preferred call time), assigns leads to advisors, batches cold databases, schedules callback reminders, keeps full transcripts and notes, and reports by lead source with role-based dashboards.
